title: Prehistory timeline strip for the unit
subject: History
unit: Spring 2: Stone Age to Iron Age (Tribal Tales)
source: Seeded from history/y3 lesson 1 (Prehistory timeline strip for the unit (portal printable))
intro: Read the text carefully. Annotate it: underline key words and write your ideas in the margin.

parts.text: Find the clue: bones of deer. Ask: why are they here? Answer: people ate deer. So they hunted deer.
Teacher does the hand axe first using the three questions.

questions.q: What can animal bones at a camp tell us?
questions.a: What animals people hunted and ate
questions.model: Find the clue: bones of deer. Ask: why are they here? Answer: people ate deer. So they hunted deer.

questions.a: To follow animals and find plants in different seasons

questions.q: Which age comes after the Stone Age?
Look at three artefact photos (hand axe, antler tool, bone needle). For each, write what it was used for.
questions.a: Hand axe: cutting; antler tool: digging or a harpoon point; bone needle: sewing skins
questions.model: Teacher does the hand axe first using the three questions.

questions.a: For example: Archaeologists know people hunted because they found animal bones

questions.q: What can evidence NOT tell us about Stone Age people?
questions.a: For example: their names, what they said, what they believed
